description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a reputable skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers an annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.

As DON, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. You will be responsible for clinical excellence, regulatory compliance, and the continuous improvement of our nursing services. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking for a leader ready to make an immediate impact.

Join a team dedicated to providing compassionate and comprehensive care. This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned nursing professional to advance their career in a challenging yet rewarding environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a nursing leadership role (e.g., ADON, DON)
Proven experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
